title: System/370 program-interruption rules
summary: Cross-cutting rules for operation/specification/fixed-point exceptions, old/new PSW handling, and exception precedence.
rules: Exception validity checks that architecturally precede operand access must execute before emulator implementation-coverage checks.
Store the architecturally required old PSW and load the complete new PSW; do not replace only the instruction address.
Preserve exception precedence: for D/5D an odd R1 is a specification exception before the storage divisor is fetched.
